messages:
Evelyn Hart: Quick thread 11 on a compact customer vignette to pair with the benchmark blog + webinar mention. Need: 15s social clip, 45s highlight, one-pager PDF, approved pull quote, and routing for demo leads.
Marco Diaz: I'll fetch the infra deltas (avg token cost, P95/P99) and drop screenshots. ETA 2pm.
Priya Shah: I can draft copy and the one-pager. Want to test two headline variants for the blog: technical (bench-first) vs customer-centric (outcome-first). Thoughts?
Aria Vance: For webinar planning, the customer can join the panel for a 5-min case highlight + 5-min live Q&A. Prefer Wed or Thu pre-launch.
Evelyn Hart: Good. Use the customer-centric headline for social + webinar mention; keep the detailed benchmarks in the one-pager.
Marco Diaz: Uploaded numbers: token cost down ~33%, P95 improved 38ms, P99 improved 120ms. Files in /files/benchmarks/vignette-May.
LegalBot: Consent required. Use template: "I consent to Redwood Inference using my quote, company name, and logo in marketing materials related to this launch. I confirm these materials are not marked or designated as confidential." Include signer name/title/date.
Priya Shah: Draft social pull: "Redwood made inference reliable and helped us ship faster." For the blog H1 option A (technical): "Benchmark: 33% lower token cost, faster tails"; option B (customer): "How X Corp shipped features faster with predictable inference".
Aria Vance: Customer prefers option B for social and webinar. For the blog, include a short methodology note about sample size and traffic patterns.
OpsBot: Routing rules ready: demo leads -> SFDC queue AE-CORE-77, dedicated interest -> AE-DED-21, press -> comms-team. Hidden form field deployment_interest added. Webhook endpoint: https://hooks.redwood.ai/lead/ae-core-77 (test mode).
Evelyn Hart: Add UTM params: utm_campaign=vignette_may&utm_source=social&utm_medium=post. Also add form checkbox: "I authorize Redwood to use my quote and logo" linking to consent PDF.
Marco Diaz: I'll embed the benchmark screenshot into the one-pager and redact any internal identifiers.
Priya Shah: Interview guide drafted: 4 questions + prompt to mention measurable impact. Dropping in /files/marketing/guides.
LegalBot: After customer signs, email signed PDF to legal@redwood.ai with name/title/timestamp. We'll log for records.
Aria Vance: Customer available Thu 11am PT for recording. I'll book and request 10s candid intro + 8s b-roll.
Evelyn Hart: Timeline check: signoff Wed AM, record Thu 11am, assets to design Thu eve, publish Fri 10am PT. PublishBot: can you kick off the asset pipeline once the signed PDF lands?
PublishBot: Affirmative. Asset checklist created and will be triggered on upload of signed_consent_vignette.pdf to /files/consents. Will also post to #marketing-live and create calendar events for webinar slide notes.
Marco Diaz: Final tech review scheduled for Wed 4pm; I'll validate wording around the 33% stat and add a short note on how we measured it.
Priya Shah: Will produce two social options and the one-pager draft by Tue EOD. Evelyn will pick which headline.
Evelyn Hart: Thanks team. Please react with :white_check_mark: when done with your item so I can move to publish.
